l1_words.meaning: to intend or plan to do something
to attend an event or watch something
a test or exam at school

pattern_explanation: Both languages borrowed these words from Latin, so their forms stayed close, but their meanings drifted apart over time in each language.
false_friend_warning: The Portuguese word 'pretender' looks like the English word 'pretend', but it means 'to intend' or 'to plan', so a student who translates it literally will say the opposite of what they mean.
